specification.scan: 800x600 progressive; 60 Hz production target subject to OEM qualification
specification.oem_basis: Period 17-inch monochrome OEM assembly, with Ball HD17H family as a candidate rather than a confirmed supplier. Published Ball HD 26-36 kHz range does not meet the 37.5 kHz target without modification. Its digital video amplifier is not evidence of grayscale support.
specification.qualification: Qualify revised deflection, analog grayscale amplifier and high-speed digital link; no stock-monitor plug compatibility or final OEM contract assumed.
specification.availability: Around June 1982; supersedes the proposed January prototype delivery.

dated_revisions.name: Logix Mono Pro 17 — HD17H analog OEM configuration
dated_revisions.oem: Ball HD-series HD17H, 17-inch horizontal-format OEM assembly, analog/linear-video option
dated_revisions.signal_path: Logix digital pixel index -> AION palette/controller -> 4-bit intensity DAC -> level-matched Ball analog input and linear amplifier. TTL/ECL-only input is not sufficient.
dated_revisions.rgb_palette_mapping: Preserve the 12-bit RGB command format. For grayscale, equal-channel values 000,111,...,FFF map to the corresponding 16 intensity codes. Other RGB values use a documented fixed luminance mapping, with DAC/gamma calibration qualified on the actual CRT.
dated_revisions.qualification: Ball documents 26-36 kHz horizontal and 40-80 Hz vertical; optional linear amplifier is 35 MHz typical. 60 Hz at the selected totals needs a qualified OEM deflection revision. Pixel clock is not analog bandwidth: test actual contrast, grayscale settling, geometry and corner focus. 56 Hz/35 kHz is a fallback engineering option, not a silently substituted retail specification.
dated_revisions.supplier_status: Selected OEM design basis in the alternative timeline; actual ordering code and commercial supply terms remain unspecified.
